Online edit

Definition

Online edit is the high-resolution finishing stage that conforms approved editorial decisions and prepares final masters. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align post decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
